posts.text: Last weekend, Anthony Stefanuto and I built SunPay at Hack the 6ix and won Best Use of Auth0 from Major League Hacking! 🏆 Every friend group has a "planner friend." You're in charge of booking the hotels, flights, or concert tickets. You shell out hundreds on your own card, max out your limit, and then spend weeks chasing everyone down for e-transfers. As an all-women team, we thought about ourselves, and the women around us - why does investing feel unintuitive, unwelcoming, and not built for us?
